title: Spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- spinning top: handle knob, stem, body, tip, motion swirls -->
  <!-- handle knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='6' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='3' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='21' width='6' height='12' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- body: wide cone -->
  <path d='M22 33 Q50 30 78 33 L56 66 Q50 70 44 66 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- body shading band -->
  <path d='M24 36 Q50 33 76 36 L70 50 Q50 46 30 50 Z' fill='#ff6b81'/>
  <!-- white stripe -->
  <path d='M33 52 Q50 48 67 52 L63 60 Q50 57 37 60 Z' fill='#fff0e0'/>
  <!-- tip -->
  <path d='M44 66 Q50 72 56 66 L50 82 Z' fill='#4ea8de'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#a0e0ff'/>
  <!-- motion swirls -->
  <path d='M14 46 Q8 56 16 64' stroke='#9bf6ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M86 46 Q92 56 84 64' stroke='#9bf6ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 72 Q26 78 34 76' stroke='#caffbf' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 72 Q74 78 66 76' stroke='#caffbf' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
